title: Blueprint for Austin's Downtown Core
summary:
*   Officials heard an in-depth presentation outlining a bold vision for the revitalization of downtown Austin, focusing on urban design and economic growth.
*   The comprehensive plan covered major proposed improvements for key areas including Congress Avenue, the Convention Center, and the Capital Campus with its gateways.
*   Discussions highlighted plans for enhancing open spaces, creating a new Arts District on the Lake, and modernizing transportation infrastructure.
*   The presentation also addressed community issues, the formation of a Downtown Management Organization, and financial strategies to fund the ambitious revitalization projects.

FOUNDED 3839
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
March 20, 1991
TOWN LAKE CENTER 2:00 Ρ.Μ.
-
Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting all members
present, except Mayor Pro Tem Urdy, who arrived at 3:19 Ρ.Μ.
The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to hear the Regional/Urban Design
Assistance Team (R/UDAT)/Economic Development Presentation.
Joe Lessard, Assistant City Manager, introduced the discussion. Levis Wright, Chairperson
of R/UDAT Implementation Committee, discussed the vision of the plan. Mark Lawless
illustrated Existing Open Space Framework, Allan Cree talked about the Capital Campus with
UT Gateway and 12th Street Gateway. The Convention Center was discussed by Alan Taniguchi
and Al Simmons told about the plans for Congress Avenue. Michael Glaros talked about
Retail Services, and Mark Lawless illustrated with charts Open Space Improvements.
Civic/Cultural aspects including Civic Plaza and Arts District on the Lake, were covered
by Cecilia Bustamante, Sinclair Black and Alan Tanaguchi. Bob Wilson's topic was Economic
Development. Farland Bundy and Celia Kupersmith told of the plans for Transportation,
including Transit and Short & Long Term Projects. Community Issues were covered by David
Austin and Downtown Management Organization was outlined by John Vorral. Karin Richmond
outlined Finance plans for the revitalization of the downtown area. Lewis Wright wrapped
up the discussion.
The meeting was recessed from 3:09 to 3:11, when discussion resumed.
Adjournment was announced at 4:25 P.Μ.
